title: MotionBricks: Scalable Real-Time Motions with Modular Latent Generative Model and Smart Primitives
abstract: Runtime interactive motion control has been one of the foundational pillars supporting animation and robotics applications. We introduce MotionBricks: a large-scale, real-time generative framework that seamlessly combines a powerful low-level latent neural backbone with a flexible, universal high-level behavior system built upon smart primitives. For the low-level neural backbone, we adopt motion in-betweening as the foundational paradigm, featuring a novel multi-head tokenizer and a progressive coarse-to-fine generation pipeline. We further introduce smart primitives — smart locomotion and smart object — that provide a unified, robust, and intuitive keyframe interface for authoring both navigation and object interaction. Quantitatively, MotionBricks produces state-of-the-art motion quality on open-source and proprietary datasets of various scales, while achieving a real-time throughput of 15,000 FPS with 2ms latency. We deploy MotionBricks on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot for real-world whole-body control.
